reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (LinkedIn Marketing API: Advertising API + Ad Analytics + Conversions API + Matched Audiences). Lane
auth: 1. Create an app at developer.linkedin.com, request the **Advertising API** product (application review). Also apply for **Conversions API** and **Matched Audiences API** when needed (Advertising API approval is a prerequisite).

2. 3-legged OAuth 2.0 (authorization code) with member permissions: `rw_ads` (manage + read ad accounts where the member is ACCOUNT_BILLING_ADMIN / ACCOUNT_MANAGER / CAMPAIGN_MANAGER / CREATIVE_MANAGER), `r_ads`, `r_ads_reporting`, `rw_dmp_segments`, `rw_conversions`. Token lifetimes: TODO(verify) o

3. fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client id of a LinkedIn app with the Advertising API product (scopes r_ads, rw_ads).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The app's client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant at https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Programmatic refresh token from the 3-legged flow (available to approved Marketing API partners; valid about one year). The runtime mints 60-day access tokens from it.

me.note: GET /rest/adAccountUsers?q=authenticatedUser: the ad accounts and roles of the member behind the token.

list_accounts.note: GET /rest/adAccounts?q=search (no criteria: every account the caller can access) with pageSize=1000 (the maximum; list_accounts takes no paging arguments). Paging is cursor-based (metadata.nextPageToken); only the first page is returned.

list_campaigns.note: GET /rest/adAccounts/{adAccountId}/adCampaigns?q=search&search.test=false (non-test campaigns; search criteria are mandatory) with an optional single status (ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED, COMPLETED, CANCELED, DRAFT, ...) as search.status.values[0]. dailyBudget.amount is a decimal string and runSchedule.start/end are epoch milliseconds, left in raw. Paging is cursor-based; only the first page is returned.

update_budget.note: Partial update: POST /rest/adAccounts/{adAccountId (config)}/adCampaigns/{campaignId} with X-RestLi-Method: PARTIAL_UPDATE and {patch: {$set: {dailyBudget: {amount: "<decimal string>", currencyCode}}}}; answers 204. Pass `currency` = the ad account's currency (ISO 4217): LinkedIn requires currencyCode and it must match the account.

pause_resume.note: Partial update with {patch: {$set: {status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}}} (pause → PAUSED, resume → ACTIVE); answers 204.

get_report.note: GET /rest/adAnalytics?q=analytics&pivot=CAMPAIGN&timeGranularity=DAILY&dateRange=(start:(year,month,day),end:(...))&accounts=List(urn%3Ali%3AsponsoredAccount%3A<account_id>)&fields=... (the documented analytics finder; Rest.li characters sent unencoded, URN colons percent-encoded as in the docs' examples). One row per campaign per day: `campaign` is the sponsoredCampaign URN, the day is dateRange.start year/month/day, spend is costInLocalCurrency (a decimal string). `campaign_id` is not applied (filter rows by campaign URN). Daily data is retained for 6 months.

config_fields.name: ad_account_id
config_fields.help: Sponsored ad account id (digits) that owns the campaigns update_budget and pause_resume change (POST /rest/adAccounts/{adAccountId}/adCampaigns/{campaignId}); those verbs take only a campaign id.
